releases.description: The supervisor loop itself: planning that reads Initiative Zero, applies reliably and reports failures honestly.

clusters.title: Toolbox session recovery for the supervisor workflow
clusters.description: From Initiative Zero's retrospectives: a toolbox deployment replaced the instance while the workflow client held an in-memory MCP session, and the client failed on HTTP 404 without reconnecting. Step 1: after a definitive missing-session response the workflow's toolbox client reinitializes a bounded number of times, checks completed-operation bookkeeping and idempotency before replaying anything, and does not blindly replay side effects after ambiguous network failures. Add a regression test that loses the session between calls. Step 2, after step 1: restrict toolbox deploy triggers to relevant source changes. CIT-450 (do not report success that did not happen) is the first member.
